title: Great earthquakes: which country?
intro: Pick the country for each earthquake, as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 1908 Messina earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of 1908 Messina earthquake (28 December 1908).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 2009 L'Aquila earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of 2009 L'Aquila earthquake (6 April 2009).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to West Pasaman earthquake 2022?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Indonesia as the country of West Pasaman earthquake 2022 (25 February 2022).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 2022 Luding earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives China as the country of 2022 Luding earthquake (5 September 2022).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 2026 Mindanao earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Philippines as the country of 2026 Mindanao earthquake (8 June 2026).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 2007 Peru earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Peru as the country of 2007 Peru earthquake (15 August 2007).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 1970 Ancash earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Peru as the country of 1970 Ancash earthquake (31 May 1970).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to 1949 Pelileo earthquake?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Ecuador as the country of 1949 Pelileo earthquake (5 August 1949).
